use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use Colour = (red: int, green: int, blue: int)

pt(x: double, y: double) -> (x: double, y: double) => (x = x, y = y)

scene() -> IMAGE is
    let image = IMAGE(160, 120)

    for y in 0..80 do
        let t = cast double(y) / 80.0D

        image.colour(
            cast ubyte(40.0D + 200.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(70.0D + 100.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(160.0D - 60.0D * t))
        image.fill_rectangle(
            0.0D, cast double(y), 160.0D, cast double(y + 1))
    od

    image.colour(255ub, 220ub, 60ub)
    image.disc(112.0D, 42.0D, 15.0D)

    image.colour(90ub, 60ub, 120ub)
    image.fill([pt(0.0D, 80.0D), pt(45.0D, 30.0D), pt(95.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(60ub, 110ub, 70ub)
    image.fill([pt(55.0D, 80.0D), pt(105.0D, 48.0D), pt(160.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(70ub, 150ub, 60ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(0.0D, 80.0D, 160.0D, 120.0D)

    image.colour(200ub, 35ub, 40ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(22.0D, 88.0D, 52.0D, 110.0D)

    image.colour(120ub, 25ub, 30ub)
    image.fill([pt(18.0D, 88.0D), pt(37.0D, 75.0D), pt(56.0D, 88.0D)])

    image.colour(250ub, 245ub, 235ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(33.0D, 97.0D, 41.0D, 110.0D)

    image
si

hue(h: double) -> Colour =>
    let part = (h * 6.0D) - Math.floor(h * 6.0D) in
    let sector = cast int(h * 6.0D) % 6 in
    let up = cast int(255.0D * part) in
    let down = cast int(255.0D * (1.0D - part)) in
    case sector
    when 0 then (255, up, 0)
    when 1 then (down, 255, 0)
    when 2 then (0, 255, up)
    when 3 then (0, down, 255)
    when 4 then (up, 0, 255)
    else (255, 0, down)
    esac

put(image: IMAGE, x: int, y: int, c: Colour) is
    image.set_pixel(
        x, y, cast ubyte(c.red), cast ubyte(c.green), cast ubyte(c.blue))
si

of(p: (red: ubyte, green: ubyte, blue: ubyte)) -> Colour =>
    (
        red = cast int(p.red),
        green = cast int(p.green),
        blue = cast int(p.blue))

picture() -> IMAGE is
    let image = scene()

    for x in 0..image.width do
        let c = hue(cast double(x) / cast double(image.width))

        for y in 0..8 do
            put(image, x, y, c)
        od
    od

    image
si

use Weighted = (colour: Colour, count: int)

channel(c: Colour, axis: int) -> int =>
    case axis when 0 then c.red when 1 then c.green else c.blue esac

spread(box: List[Weighted], axis: int) -> int =>
    let values =
        box |> map(w => channel(w.colour, axis)) |> collect_list() in
    (values |> reduce(0, int.max)) - (values |> reduce(255, int.min))

widest(box: List[Weighted]) -> int =>
    (0..3) |> reduce(0, (best, axis) =>
        if spread(box, axis) > spread(box, best) then axis else best fi)

score(box: List[Weighted]) -> int => spread(box, widest(box))

split(box: List[Weighted]) -> (List[Weighted], List[Weighted]) is
    let axis = widest(box)
    let sorted =
        box
            |> sort((a, b) =>
                channel(a.colour, axis) - channel(b.colour, axis))
            |> collect_list()

    let total = sorted |> map(w => w.count) |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a + b)
    let cut mut = 1
    let seen mut = sorted[0].count

    while cut < sorted.count - 1 /\ seen < total / 2 do
        seen = seen + sorted[cut].count
        cut = cut + 1
    od

    (
        sorted |> take(cut) |> collect_list(),
        sorted |> skip(cut) |> collect_list())
si

average(box: List[Weighted]) -> Colour is
    let n = box |> map(w => w.count) |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a + b)

    weighted(axis: int) -> int =>
        (box |> map(w => channel(w.colour, axis) * w.count)
            |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a + b)) / n

    (red = weighted(0), green = weighted(1), blue = weighted(2))
si

median_cut(colours: List[Weighted], count: int) -> List[Colour] is
    let boxes = LIST[List[Weighted]]([colours])

    while boxes.count < count do
        let largest =
            (0..boxes.count) |> reduce(0, (best, i) =>
                if score(boxes[i]) > score(boxes[best]) then i else best fi)

        let (low, high) = split(boxes[largest])

        boxes[largest] = low
        boxes.add(high)
    od

    boxes |> map(average) |> collect_list()
si

distance(a: Colour, b: Colour) -> int =>
    let dr = a.red - b.red, dg = a.green - b.green, db = a.blue - b.blue in
    dr * dr + dg * dg + db * db

nearest(palette: List[Colour], c: Colour) -> Colour =>
    palette |> reduce(palette[0], (best, p) =>
        if distance(p, c) < distance(best, c) then p else best fi)

picture().write("picture.png")

let input = IMAGE.read("picture.png")

let pixels =
    (0..input.height)
        |> flat_map(y => (0..input.width) |> map(x => input.pixel(x, y)))
        |> map(of)
        |> collect_list()

let counts = MAP[Colour, int]()

for c in pixels do
    counts[c] = if counts.contains_key(c) then counts[c] + 1 else 1 fi
od

let colours =
    counts
        |> map(kv => (colour = kv.key, count = kv.value))
        |> collect_list()

let palette = median_cut(colours, 16)

write_line("{colours.count} colours reduced to {palette.count}:")

for row in 0..4 do
    write_line(
        palette
            |> skip(row * 4)
            |> take(4)
            |> map(c => "#{c.red:X2}{c.green:X2}{c.blue:X2}")
            |> join("  "))
od

let scale = 2
let output = IMAGE(input.width * 2 * scale, input.height * scale)

for y in 0..input.height * scale do
    for x in 0..input.width * scale do
        let c = pixels[(y / scale) * input.width + x / scale]
        let q = nearest(palette, c)
        let right = x + input.width * scale

        put(output, x, y, c)
        put(output, right, y, q)
    od
od

output.write("quantized.png")

output.show("quantized.png")
